overview: CreatorOS is an AI-powered creator operating system that helps content creators run their business with AI. It combines AI content generation, productivity tracking, content planning, and subscription management into a cinematic, premium SaaS experience.
features: AI Studio with real-time word-by-word streaming (OpenAI)
Drag-and-drop Content Planner with pipeline statuses
Pomodoro Productivity System with streak tracking
Settings with AI preferences and billing management
Cinematic dark futuristic UI with glassmorphism and Framer Motion animations
